paperTitleZh: 生物 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 甲部 人體生理學：調節與控制
paperTitle: Biology Mock — Paper 2 Section A Human Physiology: Regulation and Control

parts.label: a(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 描述這女士由 44 歲至 56 歲期間促卵泡激素和雌激素水平的變化。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Describe the changes in the levels of FSH and oestrogen of this woman from the age of 44 to 56. (2 marks)

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼雌激素水平下降時，促卵泡激素水平會大幅上升。（4 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why the FSH level rises greatly as the oestrogen level falls. (4 marks)

parts.label: a(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 激素補充療法是給更年期女士服用雌激素（及孕酮）。一名醫生說：「所有更年期女士都應接受激素補充療法。」參考表二，評價這說法。（4 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Hormone replacement therapy (HRT) gives oestrogen (and progesterone) to women at menopause. A doctor said: "All women at menopause should receive HRT." With reference to Table 2, evaluate this statement. (4 marks)

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 在首 5 分鐘內，胸部皮膚溫度由 33°C 降至約 14°C，但體心溫度只改變約 0.1°C。解釋皮膚血管的反應如何令體心溫度得以維持。（4 分）
parts.questionTextEn: In the first 5 minutes, chest skin temperature fell from 33°C to about 14°C, but core body temperature changed by only about 0.1°C. Explain how the response of the skin blood vessels maintains the core body temperature. (4 marks)

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 描述並解釋這人在浸入海水首 5 分鐘內代謝率的變化。（3 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Describe and explain the change in metabolic rate of this person in the first 5 minutes in the seawater. (3 marks)

parts.label: b(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 離開海水後首 10 分鐘，這人的體心溫度仍然繼續下降。試提出解釋。（3 分）
parts.questionTextEn: In the first 10 minutes after leaving the water, the core body temperature of this person continued to fall. Suggest an explanation. (3 marks)
